title: Tracy Base EmDash 0.5.4 and Tracy SaaS EmDash 1.4.14 keep both modes under a design system and pass every built-site rule; the WordPress slot never shows an empty logo picture
steps: S1: run tests/theme-preference.test.mjs in packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-base and tracy-emdash-theme-saas (the real pre-paint and toggle scripts on one shared storage).
S2: read the slot contracts emdash-base.json and emdash-tracy-saas.json; run packages/design/tracy-ds-slot test/slot.test.mjs and test/two-modes.test.mjs.
S3: read contracts/0.5.4 and contracts/1.4.14 design-system-measurement.json of the two themes and judge them with judgeMeasurement.
S4: read tracy-base/emdash and tracy-saas/emdash in both quickstarts.json copies, each theme's package.json, template.config.json and Dockerfile.
expect: S1: both pass: a worn system opens on its own mode and stores nothing; a choice under a system is kept under the system's key; taking it off gives the template back.

S2: readsComponents, modes and the switch selector ([data-tracy-theme-toggle], .k-theme-toggle) on both; maxVersion 0.5.4 / 1.4.14; ds-slot tests pass, including the hidden empty WordPress logo picture that no block rule reaches.
S3: ROLE-1, SCREEN-1, CON-1, UNDO-1, FONT-1, IDENT-1, MODE-1 and MODE-2 all pass for both releases (0.5.2 / 1.4.12 measured 6/12: ROLE-1 failed, MODE-2 failed or unmeasurable).

S4: both copies pin 0.5.4 (zip 7070333 B 5030d7fc...50e5 asset 639429998, state 6168865 B eed25494...66c8 asset 639430000) and 1.4.14 (zip 7808844 B 1cacc1f5...0071 asset 639438922, state 7674704 B 6ce7750f...0f5b asset 639438924); every version says the same.
fence: No stand, no model, no network. The releases are on JoomlArt-Products/ja-products (tracy-base/emdash-0.x, tracy-saas/emdash-0.x); the measurements were taken on the iMac on the restored release candidates; this case reads only the repo.
